decision_policy: A candidate is not an adopted data feed. Later adapters must use only a qualified candidate and must retain the source-specific constraints below.

candidates.licence_constraint: API key required; each selected series must be checked for its owner and copyright restrictions before use.
candidates.timing_and_revisions: ALFRED real-time periods and FRED vintage-date endpoints support point-in-time retrieval.
candidates.retention: Retain identifiers, release/vintage timestamps, values, metadata and hashes; do not assume rights to redistribute third-party series.
candidates.adoption_gate: M8 must name series and demonstrate vintage-aware retrieval; M10 may use release dates only as date-precision US event context.

candidates.licence_constraint: Public ESCB statistics may be reused free of charge when source is quoted and data/metadata are not modified; third-party data needs separate permission.
candidates.timing_and_revisions: SDMX supports updatedAfter and includeHistory for revisions; preserve observed release and retrieval times.
candidates.retention: Retain original values, metadata, source attribution, release/revision lineage and hashes.
candidates.adoption_gate: M9 must select dataflows and prove metadata and revision lineage; M10 may use the public statistical calendar as CET-timestamped euro-area event context.

candidates.licence_constraint: Not adopted for the MVP because a paid plan is outside the operator budget.
candidates.timing_and_revisions: Candidate only: M10 must prove stable event identity, UTC timing, forecast/actual/previous and revision handling.
candidates.retention: No calendar payload retained or fetched by this project before approval.
candidates.adoption_gate: MVP commercial-calendar adoption requires an explicit operator licence/cost decision plus proof.

candidates.licence_constraint: Use only derived, attributable aggregate measures until source and article-level retention rights are separately reviewed; do not retain article text.
candidates.timing_and_revisions: Historical data is available, but an M11 adapter must make query time, source time, query definition and revisions explicit.
candidates.retention: Retain query definition, timestamps, aggregate output and hashes; no article text or trading-signal claim.
candidates.adoption_gate: M11 must demonstrate a bounded reproducible aggregate sample and uncertainty labelling.
